color.note: LOCKED core: Electric Blue #2047F4, Deep Navy #0A1748, Black #000000. Everything else is a tonal step of these blues, an off-black, white/off-white or a neutral grey. No other hue exists in this system - no orange, yellow, red, green, purple or brown, including for states or charts. Richness comes from type, scale, contrast and tone.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: LOCKED core colour 1 - Royal/Electric Blue. Solid Fields behind type, the Square Stop, photo backdrops, Strike on black/white. White text on it = 6.4:1. Never small text on black (3.3:1): use brand-blue-bright there.

tokens.name: brand-blue-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed / second layer of blue: a Field sitting on a blue photo backdrop, the lower block in a stacked Field. White on it = 8.6:1.

tokens.name: brand-blue-bright
tokens.usage: Blue as TEXT or thin rules on black and navy: highlighted word in a headline, hashtags, links on dark. 5.2:1 on ink-900. Never a fill behind white text (3.5:1).

tokens.name: brand-blue-soft
tokens.usage: Light blue for secondary text on navy and brand-blue-deep, and for chart/diagram secondary strokes. Use sparingly.

tokens.name: brand-blue-mist
tokens.usage: The only light tint: quiet background band on Paper layouts (website sections, carousel context slides). Text on it: ink-900.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: LOCKED core colour 2 - Deep Navy. Long-form video cards, website footer, the shadow side of the blue photo world. White text 16.9:1; brand-blue-soft 10:1. Never navy on brand-blue (2.7:1).

tokens.name: brand-navy-raised
tokens.usage: Rules, dividers and raised panels on navy. Not a text colour.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: LOCKED core colour 3 - Black. The black T-shirt, Black Fields in thumbnails and social, full-screen video cards, letterbox. White text 21:1; brand-blue-bright 5.6:1. Structural, never decorative.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Off-black. UI surfaces only (website, brand book, app chrome) where pure black is too harsh on screens; text on Paper and on brand-blue-mist. Artwork Fields use black.

tokens.name: ink-800
tokens.usage: Raised surface on ink-900 (cards, website panels).

tokens.name: grey-700
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers on dark surfaces. Not for text.

tokens.name: grey-500
tokens.usage: Muted text on Paper/white (6.0:1). Metadata, captions, source lines on light.

tokens.name: grey-400
tokens.usage: Muted text on ink-900/black (6.0:1). Metadata, sources, timestamps on dark. Not on blue.

tokens.name: grey-200
tokens.usage: Hairlines on Paper, disabled states.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Off-white. Light surface for website, carousels in light mode, documents. Warmer than white so blue reads cleaner.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Headline text on black, navy and brand-blue. Raised card on Paper.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page / canvas background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and panels sitting on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and surface-raised (>=16:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions, sources on surface (6.0:1 both themes).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and frames on surface.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Blue text on surface: highlighted words, hashtags, links (5.2:1 dark, 5.8:1 light).

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: The Field fill (primary graphic device). Text on it: on-field.

tokens.name: on-field
tokens.usage: Text and Square Stop outline on field. 6.4:1.

type.note: Arabic-first. Arabic display = Thmanyah Sans (Bold 700 / Black 900, headlines only; Light/Regular/Medium kept for oversized quiet statements). Arabic body/UI = IBM Plex Sans Arabic. English display = Archivo (semi-condensed). English text = IBM Plex Sans. Numbers and metadata = IBM Plex Mono.

families.ar-text: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: ar-hero
styles.usage: Thmanyah Sans Black. Thumbnail headline (at 1280x720), season cover, website hero. 2-6 words, max 2 lines.

styles.name: ar-display
styles.usage: Thmanyah Sans Black. Carousel hook, statement and question cards, social headlines (at 1080 wide).

styles.name: ar-title
styles.usage: Medium titles in Thmanyah Sans Bold: episode cards, chapter dividers, carousel slide titles, quotes.

styles.name: ar-subtitle
styles.sample: قبل ما تنزل Job Post جديد
styles.usage: LEVEL 02 supporting line under a display headline.

styles.name: ar-lead
styles.sample: ممكن فعلًا تكون محتاج تعيّن. بس فيه سؤال أهم.
styles.usage: LEVEL 03 context paragraphs on slides and the website.

styles.name: ar-body
styles.sample: Finance مستنيك. Operations مستنياك. الـTeam مستني موافقتك.
styles.usage: Website and article body. Max 62 characters per line.

styles.name: ar-caption
styles.usage: Captions, source lines in Arabic, footnotes.

styles.name: ar-label
styles.usage: Labels and tags in Arabic (inside an outline tag or the Index Tab).

styles.name: ar-hashtag
styles.usage: Hashtags in accent-ink. Captions and carousel footers only, never on thumbnails. Season hashtags (e.g. #تكسير_المسلمات) only during their season.

styles.name: en-hero
styles.usage: English hero on website EN / LinkedIn. Semi-condensed (font-stretch 87.5%).

styles.name: en-display
styles.sample: Before tool number 16, map the workflow.
styles.usage: English social headlines and LinkedIn covers.

styles.name: en-title
styles.usage: English name set, card titles, website section titles.

styles.name: ep-numeral
styles.usage: Giant episode / slide / step numbers. Western digits, always two digits (01, 04, 12).

styles.name: en-lead
styles.sample: 100 weekly episodes on work, business, systems and decisions.

styles.name: en-body
styles.sample: I'm not against AI. I'm against collecting tools before you know the workflow.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: LEVEL 04/05 metadata: journey count, Index Tab, sources, timestamps. Uppercase Latin, Western digits. Season prefix only during a season (S01 · 04 / 100).

styles.name: meta-lg
styles.usage: Index Tab on thumbnails and 1080 social frames.

spacing.note: 8-point base. Artboard margins are proportional (see layout tokens).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its rule.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Index Tab inner padding (y), tag padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Index Tab inner padding (x), tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Metadata to headline gap; mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Headline to subtitle gap; card padding (web).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Grid gutter at 1080/1280.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Thumbnail margin (1280x720).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Social margin (1080x1350), website gutter desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Video title-safe margin (1920x1080), website section spacing.

radius.note: The system is square. The only round shape is the platform's own avatar circle.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything: Fields, Tabs, cards, buttons, image crops.

tokens.name: radius-avatar
tokens.usage: Only where a platform crops the avatar to a circle. Never designed in.

tokens.name: rule-hair
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers on web and documents.

tokens.name: rule-edit
tokens.usage: Editorial rules in social frames, outline tags.

tokens.name: rule-bar
tokens.usage: Lower-third bar, chapter rule in video (at 1920).

tokens.name: strike-weight
tokens.usage: SEASON 01 ONLY: thickness of the Strike (the season gesture) relative to the headline size. Not a master device.

tokens.name: stop-size
tokens.usage: Square unit edge relative to the text it follows (signature, bullets). One square = one unit of the 100 Journey.

tokens.name: mark-pad
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of the Mark (master supporting device): the solid block behind the one word that carries the idea.

layout.note: Artboard sizes and the seam positions (the vertical edge where Field meets photo).

tokens.name: thumb-size
tokens.usage: YouTube thumbnail artboard.

tokens.name: thumb-margin
tokens.usage: Outer margin on thumbnails.

tokens.name: thumb-seam
tokens.usage: Field width in templates A/B (portrait gets 44%).

tokens.name: video-safe
tokens.usage: Title-safe margin on 1920x1080.

tokens.name: post-margin
tokens.usage: Margin on 1080x1350 posts and carousels.

tokens.name: vertical-safe-top
tokens.usage: Keep clear at the top of 1080x1920 (platform UI).

tokens.name: vertical-safe-bottom
tokens.usage: Keep clear at the bottom of 1080x1920 (caption + buttons).

tokens.name: vertical-safe-side
tokens.usage: Keep clear on the right edge of 1080x1920 (action buttons).

tokens.name: grid-columns
tokens.usage: Columns on every artboard; seams fall on column 5 or 7.

tokens.name: journey-grid
tokens.usage: The 100 Journey grid: 20 columns x 5 rows (the five 20-episode horizons). Cell gap = 0.375 x cell.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Labels, tabs, hard-cut-adjacent moves, exits.

tokens.name: dur-normal
tokens.usage: Field wipes, text mask reveals, lower thirds.

tokens.name: dur-emphasis
tokens.usage: Strike draw, Field expansion, the season opener.

tokens.name: ease-snap
tokens.usage: Every entrance: fast start, clean stop.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Every exit.
